title: Even Squares
hints: Build the pipeline step by step: first print the stream of numbers, then add filter, then map.
n -> n % 2 == 0 is a lambda: a small function that receives n and returns true or false.
Collectors.joining(" ") returns an empty String when nothing passed the filter.
